title: Arrow of Darkness
summary: Deals weapon damage and creates a 10 ft-radius Darkness area for 3 turns.

fields.Activation: Action. Fire from a ranged weapon and consume one arrow. Range 60 ft.
fields.Effect: Deals weapon damage and creates a 10 ft-radius Darkness area for 3 turns.
fields.Restrictions: Special arrows cannot be used with off-hand ranged attacks.
fields.Crafting: Special arrows are obtained from loot or vendors.
fields.Creative use: Screen an approach or retreat with the cloud.
fields.Base value: 20 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Darkness: The area is heavily obscured, blinds creatures inside and blocks ranged attacks into or out of it. Firing preserves Hiding and Invisibility, even when it deals damage.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
